title: Bombay High Court grants Indian minister Nitin Gadkari leave to sue Meta, X and Google over AI deepfakes
reason: Published: procedural order (27 July 2026, Bombay HC, Justice Abhay Ahuja) granting Union Minister Nitin Gadkari leave under Letters Patent Clause XII to sue Meta, X Corp and Google/YouTube over alleged AI deepfakes about the E20 fuel policy. Cross-confirmed via direct fetch of two independent named-byline legal-press outlets (LiveLaw, Bar and Bench) plus ~20 corroborating mainstream Indian outlets, all consistent. open_obligation set because this is only a leave-to-sue order: no ruling on the merits, no interim relief granted yet, substantive suit and interim-relief request to be heard later before Justice Arif Doctor, and defendants have not yet responded.
